O Que Temos Para Você

title: Estagiário de engenharia
description:
Sobre a DTX

A DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.

Sobre o trabalho

Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de engenharia.

O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação técnica de futuros engenheiros especialistas em trem de pouso em processos de MRO.

O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de " job rotation " para que possa aprender sobre o processo de trens de pouso de forma global.

1. Suporte de projeto e engenharia

Tarefas:

  • Apoiar os engenheiros na análise e revisão das especificações do projeto.
  • Auxiliar na avaliação de desenhos, esquemas e especificações para componentes do trem de pouso.
  • Saiber como as equipes de engenharia dão suporte ao processo de produção e manutenção.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Compreensão dos princípios de design para componentes aeroespaciais
  • Familiaridade com software CAD e desenhos de engenharia
  • Técnicas de resolução de problemas em engenharia aeroespacial

2. Análise de Tensão e Teste de Material

Tarefas de rotação:

  • Auxiliar em cálculos de análise de tensão ou simulações para componentes do trem de pouso.
  • Participar de testes de materiais, como testes de tração, fadiga e corrosão.
  • Observar o uso da Análise de Elementos Finitos (FEA) para componentes do trem de pouso.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Princípios básicos de estresse, tensão e ciência dos materiais
  • Uso de ferramentas de simulação (por exemplo, FEA)
  • Aplicação de testes de materiais em engenharia aeronáutica

3. Conformidade Regulatória e Documentação

Tarefas:

  • Saber mais sobre o papel dos órgãos reguladores (FAA, ANAC, EASA...) nas operações de MRO.
  • Auxiliar na documentação dos procedimentos de manutenção, inspeção e reparo.
  • Entender como manter a conformidade com os padrões de aeronavegabilidade.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Familiaridade com normas e certificações regulatórias
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento e rastreamento de documentação
  • Atenção aos protocolos de conformidade e aeronavegabilidade

4. Gestão e Coordenação de Projetos

Tarefas:

  • Acompanhar os gerentes de projeto para entender o agendamento e a alocação de recursos.
  • Auxiliar no gerenciamento de cronogramas e documentação de projetos para projetos de revisão de trens de pouso.
  • Ajudar na coordenação entre as equipes de produção, engenharia e qualidade.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo e coordenação de projetos
  • Compreensão das ferramentas e técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos
  • Comunicação e colaboração interdepartamental

5. Suporte de campo e interação com o cliente

Tarefas:

  • Auxiliar na prestação de suporte técnico aos clientes (companhias aéreas, militares, etc.) quando necessário.
  • Observar as visitas dos clientes e ajude a explicar os processos de reparo.
  • Participar da análise de causa raiz para problemas recorrentes de trem de pouso.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Habilidades de comunicação com o cliente em um contexto técnico
  • Resolução de problemas e análise de causa raiz
  • Coordenação entre engenharia e atendimento ao cliente

Requisitos e informações da vaga:

  • O candidato deve obrigatoriamente estar cursando nível superior em Engenharia.
  • A instituição de ensino deve fornecer à empresa um modelo de contrato de estágio.
  • Duração inicial de 06 meses podendo ser renovado por mais 06 meses com chance de efetivação ao final.
  • O candidato precisa ter disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial na área industrial do Aeroporto do Galeão - RJ.

title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst

Atualmente, FTR desenvolve projetos com IA, plataformas de analytics e programas de GRC para gestão, compliance, mitigação de riscos | fraudes. title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.

You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.

  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

title: Analista de Seguros Júnior -Vaga exclusiva para PcD
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
About you

You are a senior-level DevOps Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You're comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in senior or staff-level DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Professional certifications such as Azure DevOps, Terraform, or similar (preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent).
  • Strong proficiency with Azure services, including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure OpenAI.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
  • Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and related toolchains.
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
  • Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
  • Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
  • Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
  • Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote DevOps culture, automation, and continuous improvement.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: LATAM-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America's, particularly Argentina's, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.

Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a hands-on DevOps or Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and building reliable, cloud-native environments on AWS. You are comfortable working with Terraform, provisioning container-based infrastructure, and ensuring platform stability through proper monitoring and observability.

You bring a proactive mindset, enjoy questioning technical decisions, and collaborate closely with distributed teams to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, and scalability.

  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months, with the possibility of extension.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud, including writing modules and managing provisioning workflows.
  • Proven experience provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure, primarily ECS and related container services.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and container-based architectures.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability using CloudWatch and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with compliance practices and security-driven infrastructure changes.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, comfortable reviewing and questioning technical decisions and architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot (nice to have).

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Write and maintain Terraform code and modules to provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform Cloud.
  • Review Terraform pull requests and provide feedback to ensure code quality and best practices.
  • Provision AWS services and work on proofs of concept (PoCs) to validate infrastructure solutions.
  • Apply infrastructure and configuration changes driven by Security and Compliance requirements.
  • Review and challenge architecture and implementation approaches to drive continuous improvement.
  • Participate in team ceremonies, including daily standups and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.
  • Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (ECS and container services).
  • Experience with Docker, CloudWatch, and Datadog.
  • Conversational English (B2+).

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
  • Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;

  • Vivência em análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com leitura crítica de indicadores de resultado;
  • Domínio de indicadores como: margem, custos, vendas, SSS, rentabilidade e performance operacional;

  • Habilidade para traduzir dados complexos em insights claros;
  • Excel avançado e experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (ex.: Power BI, similares).

description:

title: Analista de Validação de Processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).

3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.

You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
Código da Vaga: 58095

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. description: About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories. Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels. Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English.Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.Our compensation package: - Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT). - Profit Sharing. - Transportation vouchers. - Meals vouchers. - Health and Dental insurance. - Birthday day off. - Gympass / Totalpass.If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. title: Master Data Modeler
description: Position Summary and LocationSupport the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.Duties and Responsibilities Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data. Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies. Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices. Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data. Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures. Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems. Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems. Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications. Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes. Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage. Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members. Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus. Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures. Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools. Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures. Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.Desired Qualifications Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design. Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL. Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description: About YouYou are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams. You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones. Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management. Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments. Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance. Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity. Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture. Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards. Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication. Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have). Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices. Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation. Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging. Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines. Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation. Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity. Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls. Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption. Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams. Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML) Advanced English proficiency. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Analista Customer Service
description: Sobre a empresa:Grande Porte no segmento de materiais de construção.O que você irá fazer: Gestão ponta a ponta do ciclo do pedido, desde a entrada até faturamento e entrega, com análise crítica e lançamento de pedidos complexos no SAP. Acompanhamento e análise de indicadores de Customer Service e Supply Chain (OTIF, On Time Delivery, Lean Rate, tempo de atendimento e resolução de problemas), com elaboração de relatórios e dashboards em Excel avançado, Tableau e Power BI. Atuação em governança de performance, promovendo análises comparativas, identificação de gaps e discussões estratégicas para melhoria contínua. Participação em projetos cross funcionais (ex.: Knauf Order, transporte e capacidade), atuando de forma integrada com PCP, Compras, Logística, Comercial, Financeiro e Transporte. Atendimento multicanal (WhatsApp, e-mail e telefone) e interface com diferentes perfis de clientes, negociando indicadores e alinhando expectativas. Atuação como referência técnica da área, com liderança indireta, apoio ao desenvolvimento do time júnior e disseminação de boas práticas orientadas a dados.Habilidades desejadas: Forte foco no cliente e visão de impacto no negócio; Maturidade profissional (postura ética, positiva, sem envolvimento em conflitos improdutivos); Perfil analítico, organizado e estruturado; Proatividade, dinamismo e senso de responsabilidade; Capacidade de influenciar sem cargo formal de liderança.O que você precisa ter: Ensino Superior completo administração, comercial ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em Customer Service e Comercial Interno ; Vivência comprovada com gestão de pedidos complexos em SAP; Forte atuação com indicadores de Supply Chain; Excel avançado (obrigatório); Inglês Avançado; Capacidade de lidar com alto volume de informações e demandas simultâneas.Observações: Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido (3x Presencial e 2x Home Office) Horário de trabalho: 9h às 18h. Revezamento com a equipe para plantão aos sábados – 1x/mês Local de trabalho: Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro/RJ.Benefícios: Vale Refeição Vale Alimentação Assistência médica e odontológica extensível a dependentes Seguro de vida Wellhub

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description: About You You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones. Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management. Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments. Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance. Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity. Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture. Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards. Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication. Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have). Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices. Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation. Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging. Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines. Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation. Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity. Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls. Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption. Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams. Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML) Advanced English proficiency.Additional Information About UsAtApplaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with anAI-native mindsetat the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values:Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication.These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Gerente De Comunicação (Interna)
description: Sobre a empresaDesde o século XIX, a Granado encanta gerações com produtos de qualidade e uma abordagem sustentável. A marca, com mais de 150 anos, mantém valores sólidos e acompanha as necessidades de seu tempo, crescendo sem perder a essência.Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, destacando-se por fragrâncias marcantes e de alta qualidade. Phebo se tornou sinônimo de luxo e excelência no mercado brasileiro. Acreditamos que o clássico não precisa ser antigo, utilizando cores vivas, fragrâncias atuais e ingredientes modernos.Nossa história centenária apoia um futuro inovador, presente em cada produto, loja e embalagem. Valorizamos o bem-estar, a segurança no trabalho e a preservação ambiental. Nosso sucesso é fruto de equipes qualificadas e apaixonadas. Diariamente, escrevemos novos capítulos dessa trajetória de sucesso.Grupo Granado abre as portas para você!Como Gerente de Comunicação Interna, reportando-se à Gerência Executiva de Recursos Humanos, você terá papel chave de estruturar e consolidar a estratégia de Comunicação Interna do Grupo Granado, fortalecendo a cultura, promovendo alinhamento institucional e assegurando uma comunicação clara e estratégica em momentos estratégicos, sensíveis ou de transformação.Principais atribuições:Liderar a agenda de Comunicação Interna, definindo diretrizes, governança, prioridades e posicionamento. Atuar como consultor, aconselhando gestores, traduzindo temas complexos em mensagens claras e apoiando decisões. Desenvolver e implementar iniciativas de cultura, engajamento e employer branding, conectando EVP, propósito e práticas de RH. Estruturar narrativas corporativas, discursos executivos e comunicações para público interno. Desenvolver campanhas, ativações e projetos de grande impacto, com foco em mobilização, engajamento, pertencimento e consistência de marca empregadora. Gerenciar indicadores, percepções internas e clima organizacional, propondo planos de ação estratégicos. Gerenciar canais institucionais internos garantindo comunicação integrada: intranet, newsletters, town halls, eventos executivos, notas estratégicas e comunicados oficiais internos. Administrar orçamento, fornecedores, com visão de eficiência e excelência.O que buscamos?Formação completa em Comunicação, Jornalismo, RP, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em liderança de Comunicação Interna, preferencialmente em empresas estruturadas ou de grande porte. Forte habilidade de relacionamento em todos os níveis, influência e visão estratégica do negócio. Excelência em comunicação escrita, narrativa corporativa e gestão de mensagens sensíveis. Necessário Inglês. Diferenciais: Experiência em bens de consumo, varejo premium ou marcas com identidade institucional forte. Visão estratégica ampla, alta capacidade de influência, leitura de ambiente, raciocínio crítico, organização e habilidade para navegar em contextos complexos com discrição e clareza.Atuação presencial em nossa Matriz no RJ.Confira o que você pode esperar:-Um ambiente integrado, leve e acolhedor, onde a colaboração, o respeito e a parceria fazem parte da nossa rotina.-Horário flexível, promovendo mais autonomia para você organizar sua rotina e ganhar qualidade de vida.-Vale-Refeição, para você aproveitar suas pausas com tranquilidade e bons momentos.-Plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida, porque cuidar de você e de quem você ama é prioridade.-TotalPass, incentivando o movimento, a energia e o equilíbrio entre corpo e mente.-Descontos exclusivos nas nossas marcas:Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty— porque quem faz parte também merece aproveitar.-Um ambiente que estimula a criatividade, a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo, com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio doPrograma de Educação Continuada , que inclui subsídios para cursos de aprimoramento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.-Parcerias educacionais com instituições comoEstácio e Open English , facilitando ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.-Programa de Participação nos Resultados , valorizando e reconhecendo quem cresce junto e contribui com nossa história.Escritório noEdifício Vista Guanabara , com uma vista inspiradora que traz mais leveza e bem-estar à rotina de trabalhoAqui, tradição e inovação caminham lado a lado — e você pode fazer parte disso!

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences. As an IB World School, we are looking for an educator who can seamlessly integrate maker-centered learning with the Primary Years Programme (PYP) curriculum. Working closely with classroom teachers and specialists, this educator will design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based projects that nurture innovation, design thinking, a maker mindset, and strong foundations in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) for students from Kindergarten to Grade 5.

The ideal candidate is:

  • Holds a Bachelor’s degree in Pedagogy and Arts, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics.
  • Has 3–5 years of qualified teaching experience, preferably in an international school context.
  • A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
  • A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
  • Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
  • Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
  • Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
  • And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects.

If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

title: Líder De Vendas
description:
Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:


Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca. Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada. Utilizar conhecimento e experiência para vender aos consumidores, atendê-los e alcançar excelência operacional, além de executar operações de loja perfeitamente quando for responsável pelo fluxo de produtos entre a área de vendas, o estoque e/ou o caixa, seguindo os procedimentos.


Principais Responsabilidades:


- Apoiar as operações de vendas da loja e os funcionários como terceiro responsável, cumprindo a função de gerente responsável na ausência do Store Manager e do Assistant Store Manager para assegurar o gerenciamento e a supervisão da loja, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.

- Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

- Contribuir para que as políticas e os procedimentos da loja sejam cumpridos de forma a manter um ambiente de trabalho e de compras seguro e apoiar o treinamento da equipe para garantir os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos.

- Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.

- Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.

- Apoiar o Store Manager no treinamento da equipe em todas as ferramentas e soluções de vendas digitais e omnicanais, além de prestar atendimento de pós-venda para garantir uma experiência de compra perfeita.

- Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, incluindo Foundational e Seasonal Brand, além de ter conhecimento sobre o produto, colocando o aprendizado na prática com eficácia.

- Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos:


- Conhecimento de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.

- Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

- Conectar, engajar e inspirar ativamente os consumidores.

apoiar iniciativas de automação e governança de processos.

- Garantir evolução e melhorias para solução de GRC implementada.

- Certificação em Agile/Scrum (PSM, CSM) ou PMP com ênfase em metodologias ágeis;

You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You’re comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in senior or staff-level DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Professional certifications such as Azure DevOps, Terraform , or similar (preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent).
  • Strong proficiency with Azure services, including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure OpenAI.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
  • Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps , and related toolchains.
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
  • Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
  • Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
  • Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
  • Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote DevOps culture, automation, and continuous improvement.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidadepara trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Nurse Offshore
